content: अवगीत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Sung in a discordant tone, sung badly. .²2 Reproached, abused, censured; अनवगीतः परिचयः <ls>U. 2. 2</ls>; अवगीतां गमिते दशामिमाम् <ls>Ki. 2. 7</ls>; सोढावगीतप्रथमायुधस्य <ls n="Ki.">17. 28</ls>; <ls>Śi. 11. 10</ls>. .²3 Wicked, vile. .²4 Satirized in a song. .²5 Seen frequently, well-known (मुहुर्दृष्ट). .{@-तम्@} .²1 A satire in song, derision. .²2 Reproach, blame. .²3 Bad or discordant singing: <ab>cf.</ab> … अवगीतं तु गर्हिते . जन्योपश्लिष्टयोर्वाच्यलिङ्गःकुत्सितकूजिते . <ls>Nm.</ls>
